metadata.title: Meet.AI — AI meeting assistant: notes, summaries and Q&A
metadata.description: Invite AI into your meeting like a teammate: it answers by voice, takes notes, summarizes, and answers questions about the meeting.

commandPalette.placeholder: Find a meeting, an agent, or type a command…

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Customize how Meet.AI looks and which language it uses.
settings.appearanceDescription: Choose light, dark, or follow your device setting.
settings.languageDescription: The display language of the app.

states.errorDescription: Please try again in a moment.

panel.title: Meetings with an AI that listens, speaks and remembers
panel.point1: AI joins the call and answers out loud
panel.point2: Notes, summaries and action items right after the meeting
panel.point3: Ask about anything that was said

validation.nameMin: Name must be at least 2 characters.
validation.passwordMin: Password must be at least 8 characters.

auth.terms: By continuing, you agree to our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

signUp.title: Get started for free
signUp.subtitle: Create your Meet.AI account
signUp.checkInboxDescription: We sent a verification link to {email}. Open it to activate your account.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a reset link.
forgot.sentDescription: If an account exists for that email, we sent a link to reset your password. The link expires in 1 hour.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.expiredDescription: This password reset link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.
reset.success: Your password has been reset. Please sign in.

errors.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Please verify your email first. We just sent you a new verification link.
errors.USER_ALREADY_EXISTS: This email is already registered. Please sign in.
errors.INVALID_TOKEN: This link is invalid or has expired.
errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many attempts. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.generic: We couldn't complete your request. Please try again.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you are looking for doesn't exist or has moved.

askAi.title: Ask AI about this meeting
askAi.placeholder: Ask anything that was said in the meeting…
askAi.emptyDescription: Answers come from the summary and transcript, with timestamps so you can check them.
askAi.suggestion2: Who needs to do what, and by when?
askAi.rateLimited: You've asked a lot this hour. Try again in {minutes} minutes or upgrade your plan.
askAi.error: The AI is busy right now. Please try again shortly.

meetingDetail.recordingUnavailable: The recording is not available for this meeting.

call.lobbySubtitle: Check your camera and microphone before joining.
call.permissionHint: Please allow your browser to use the camera and microphone.
call.consent: I understand this meeting is recorded and an AI assistant takes notes.
call.captionsUnsupported: Live captions don't support Vietnamese yet. The Vietnamese transcript is created after the meeting.
call.askAiHint: The AI answers the latest question
call.chatEmpty: Messages are only visible to people in the call.
call.endConfirmDescription: Everyone will be disconnected and the AI will start writing the notes.
call.removeConfirmDescription: They won't be able to join this meeting again.
call.leftDescription: The meeting ends a few minutes after everyone has left. The notes are created after that.
call.endedDescription: Your notes will be ready in a few minutes.
call.rateTitle: How helpful was the AI in this meeting?

aiModes.conversationalHint: The AI talks naturally. Best for 1:1 practice.
aiModes.on_demandHint: The AI only answers when called by name or when someone presses “Ask AI”.
aiModes.facilitatorHint: Same as above, plus periodic time and agenda checks.
aiModes.silentHint: The AI never speaks, only takes notes. Uses no AI minutes.

join.waitingTitle: Waiting for the host to let you in…
join.waitingDescription: The host can see your request. Keep this page open.
join.removedTitle: You were removed from this meeting
join.lockedDescription: The host isn't letting anyone else in right now.
join.endedDescription: This link can no longer be used.
join.notFoundDescription: The invite link is wrong or has been changed.

invite.title: Invite people
invite.description: Share the link with anyone, even people without an account.
invite.regenerated: New link created. The old one no longer works.
